svg.title: How the proof sessions build on each other
svg.desc: Six Isabelle/HOL sessions form one chain: Cross-Domain State Preservation imports HOL-Library, HOL-Eisbach and the AFP session ADS_Functor; Regulatory Action Composition, Cross-Chain Message Integrity, Preemptive Lock Correctness, Evidence Atomic Binding and Evidence Binding Composition each import the session before them. Protected Behavior Obstructions imports HOL only and is independent of the chain. The OIP prototype builds on Evidence Atomic Binding with nine core sessions: base model, product model, reference profile, reference execution, message code, response model and response egress in a line, with record reopening on the product model and the recovery boundary on the reference profile. 167 OIP extension sessions by purpose: authority and asset effects 61, state sync and reads 39, persistence and recovery 21, ordering and settlement 17, wire and authentication 15, responses and receipts 14. All of them build on the core sessions except four sessions in the wire and authentication group, which import Isabelle/HOL only and are drawn as outlines. Lines show ROOT imports, not deployment steps or whole-implementation verification.
